At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
Flix is reshaping how customers get help, moving towards AI-driven resolution across every channel, language, and market. Before a process can be automated, someone has to understand it, write it down, and get it confirmed - completely, precisely, and in a form an engineer can build from. That someone is you.
As Working Student in the Customer Service Automation Centre of Excellence , you are the front end of our automation pipeline: you talk to the people who run our Customer Service processes today, document how things actually work (not how the slide says they work), and validate every rule and exception until it is build-ready. The quality of your documentation directly determines how fast we automate.
This position is part-time (20 hours per week) , based in our Berlin office (hybrid model).

Process discovery: interview Customer Service agents, team leads, and process owners to capture how refund and service processes really run day to day, including the exceptions and workarounds nobody wrote down
Documentation: turn what you learn into standardized, concise process documents – trigger, steps, decision rules, systems touched, exceptions, volumes (following our one-page template in Confluence)
Validation: walk each documented process back through its owner, cross-check it against real cases, resolve contradictions, and get explicit sign-off before it is handed to the automation team
Business rules capture: express eligibility and handling rules as clean decision tables (if X and Y, then Z) that the Process Intelligence Engineer can implement directly, with every ambiguity flagged rather than glossed over
Data-driven process analysis: use our process mining platform (Celonis) to surface hidden bottlenecks, deviations, and volume patterns that interviews alone won't reveal; bring those findings into your documentation and flag them as automation opportunities
Pipeline ownership: maintain the documentation backlog so the automation team always has a queue of validated, build-ready processes; track status from "drafted" to "validated" to "built"
Upkeep and cleanup: keep documentation current as processes change, and convert existing legacy documentation (much of it diagram-only) into the standard text-based format

Enrolled student: in business informatics, business administration, industrial engineering, information systems, or a comparable programme, available ~20 hours per week for 6 months
Strong communicator: you are comfortable approaching busy people, asking questions until things actually add up, and summarizing back what you heard to confirm you got it right
Structured and detail-oriented: you notice when step 3 contradicts step 7; your notes are documents other people can work from, not reminders only you understand
Business and process judgment: you want to understand why a rule exists and what happens at the edges, not just record the happy path; you can tell the difference between a rule, a habit, and an exception. You look for patterns across cases rather than treating each one in isolation.
Clear written English: complete, concise, and neat; you would rather write half a page that is right than three pages that are vague
Nice to have: basics of process mapping or flowcharts (e.g. BPMN), familiarity with Confluence or Jira, first exposure to customer service or process improvement work, hands-on experience with a process mining tool (Celonis, Disco, ProM or similar)
We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

As the Manager, Quality Assurance within Customer Support, you will play a key role in shaping how we measure, maintain, and improve the quality of our customer experience across every support interaction.

You’ll lead the evolution of our QA program, helping define the frameworks, processes, and operational strategies that enable our teams to deliver consistent, high-quality support at scale.

By leveraging AI-powered QA tooling, you’ll surface actionable insights, identify emerging themes, and help drive continuous improvements in support quality and team performance.
Our QA program is still in its early stages, with foundational processes already in place but significant opportunity to iterate, expand, and mature the function over time. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in evolving environments and is excited by the opportunity to help shape a modern QA program while balancing strategic ownership with hands-on execution.
Reporting into Customer Support leadership, you will partner closely with Support Operations, frontline leaders, Enablement, Product, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for operational improvement, coaching, and quality enhancements across the customer journey. You’ll help establish scalable QA methodologies, calibration practices, reporting structures, and feedback loops that drive accountability and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
In this role, you’ll also help shape how QA supports AI-powered customer experiences. As AI-assisted workflows and responses continue to evolve, you’ll evaluate both human and AI-generated customer interactions to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the customer experience we aim to deliver. Your ability to identify trends, uncover friction points, and drive targeted quality initiatives will directly influence both team effectiveness and customer experience.
This role has the potential to evolve into direct people leadership of QA specialists or QA team leads as the function grows.
How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster.

AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting QA results, performance metrics, and customer feedback to drive operational improvements.

Define, evolve, and operationalize a centralized quality assurance strategy across customer support channels, including email, chat, messaging, and voice.

Analyze QA results, customer interactions, CSAT trends, and operational performance data to identify coaching opportunities, process improvements, and targeted areas requiring additional QA oversight.
Identify high-impact moments across the customer journey where deeper QA focus is needed, including low CSAT interactions, escalations, complex workflows, or AI-assisted conversations.
Partner with Support Operations and frontline leadership to translate QA insights into actionable recommendations, operational improvements, and ongoing training opportunities.
Evaluate both team member and AI-generated customer interactions to ensure responses are accurate, effective, compliant, and aligned with quality standards and brand expectations.

Develop reporting, analyses, and presentations that communicate QA performance, trends, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership teams.

Mercury is evolving how we think about Quality — moving from a primarily scorecard-based model toward an insights-driven, coaching-focused approach that helps teams learn, improve, and scale responsibly.
We're looking for a Senior Quality Analyst to join us during this evolution. This role sits at the intersection of quality expertise, AI-assisted analysis, and cross-functional partnership—supporting compliance and integrity work while helping us leverage AI to better understand customer interactions at scale and translate those insights into meaningful improvements.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Drive quality consistency and operational integrity: Review customer interactions to assess compliance, risk, and quality standards, applying strong judgment in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios. Lead and contribute to calibration efforts that strengthen fairness, alignment, and consistency across quality evaluations.
Deliver behavior-based quality insights: Provide thoughtful, actionable feedback on customer interactions, identifying strengths, opportunities, and recurring behaviors that support coaching, skill development, and performance improvement.
Investigate patterns and uncover meaningful signals at scale: Leverage AI-assisted tools, QA data, and qualitative analysis to identify recurring behaviors, risks, and opportunity areas across large volumes of customer interactions, surfacing trends that would be difficult to identify through manual review alone.
Connect insights to root causes and operational improvements: Distinguish between agent behavior, process gaps, and product or tooling issues to identify root causes and translate findings into actionable recommendations for quality processes, workflows, and customer experience improvements.
Translate insights into coaching and cross-functional action: Synthesize patterns and signals into clear, actionable guidance for Leadership, Enablement, and cross-functional partners, helping drive follow-through and measurable improvements across support operations.
Contribute to the evolution of the Quality model: Support experimentation, iterative improvement, and new approaches to understanding customer interactions at scale as Mercury continues evolving toward a more insights-driven, AI-assisted Quality function.

2–4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or a related Customer Experience role, ideally in a fast-paced, operationally complex, or regulated environment
Strong quality judgment and systems thinking: You can evaluate how work is done — not just outcomes — and identify patterns, root causes, and opportunities for improvement across people, processes, and tooling
Insight generation and problem-solving skills : You’re able to investigate open-ended questions using QA data, qualitative examples, and AI-assisted analysis, translating patterns into clear, actionable recommendations that support coaching and operational improvement
Cross-functional communication and influence: You build trust across teams, communicate insights clearly, surface risks and gaps proactively, and help stakeholders align on actions and move improvement efforts forward through strong follow-through and coordination
Ownership, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset: You operate effectively in evolving environments, move ideas into action with minimal guidance, and proactively identify ways to improve systems, workflows, and quality practices over time
AI-assisted quality tooling experience: Experience using AI-assisted analysis tools (such as Rippit, Claude, or similar platforms) to investigate customer interactions, identify meaningful patterns, and support operational decision-making. Curiosity and experience refining prompts or queries to improve signal quality and reduce noise is highly valued.

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we’re on a mission to power real work, with real impact.
We’re trusted by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including Wise, On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we’re tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.
At Perk, we’re driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you’re excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we’d love you on the team.

Join Perk as a key member of our Customer Care team, where you will play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional customer experiences. As a representative of Perk, you’ll help resolve a variety of inquiries, provide insightful support, and ensure every interaction contributes to our commitment to excellence.
In this role, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams and learn our ever-evolving product suite, helping customers navigate their needs while upholding our values of transparency, empathy, and efficiency.

Respond to customer queries via email and phone in a timely and knowledgeable manner
Troubleshoot and resolve issues while providing accurate information and following up as needed
Document interactions and escalate complex cases to the appropriate teams
Ownership of incoming requests from customers, including the creation of tickets for the internal organization
Ownership for tracking-to-resolution of recorded incidents or bugs
Answering and handling customer inquiries for our customers in Germany, Switzerland, and the rest of Europe
Internally, you’re the first point of contact for knowledge on the operational use of our software

Background in finance and or accounting is a strong plus
Operational experience with a high turnover of external customer inquiries and internal clarifications from the team is a plus
Ability to handle a variety of tasks at a high frequency
Structured and detail oriented approach to work
Fluency in English and German , additional languages are a plus

30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.
We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.
We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.
How We Work
At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.
For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.
Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.
Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page.

We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond.

Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.
We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.
We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.
How We Work
At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.
For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.
Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.
Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page.

We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond.

Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Powering the Pacific Northwest: Be the Force Behind Our Federal Workforce! Step into a pivotal role at the heart of the Pacific Northwest's energy future. Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) is renowned for providing an abundant, efficient, and reliable power supply, all while championing environmental stewardship.

Our work powers millions of homes and businesses throughout the Pacific Northwest. To achieve this mission, we need a dedicated and talented workforce. As an Operations Support Specialist on one of our Human Resources teams, you will be a key player in hiring, developing, and supporting the incredible people who keep the lights on.

This is more than a job; it's a launchpad for your federal HR career. You will gain hands-on experience and develop a broad foundation of skills in a dynamic, supportive environment. Your work will directly impact the well-being of our employees and the success of our organization.

As part of a team, you will learn one of the core functions of federal human resources from the ground up. As an Operations Support Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our HR team.

While all roles share core responsibilities in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our employee data, you will be assigned to a specialized team where you can deepen your expertise.

Your specific duties will be focused within one of the following key HR functions: Core Responsibilities (All Teams): Be a Guardian of Data Integrity: Process a wide range of personnel actions with precision, interpreting federal guidelines to apply correct processing codes and legal justifications, ensuring every detail is accurate and every employee's record is secure.

Potential Areas of Specialization: Recruitment and Placement: Shape our workforce by playing a direct role in attracting top talent. You'll prepare recruitment packages, draft compelling job announcements for a variety of federal roles, and ensure a smooth and compliant hiring process.

Classification and Position Management: Master the art of organizational design by helping to determine appropriate job titles, series, and pay grades, ensuring fairness and equity across the agency.

Benefits: Guide employees through their most important career milestones by helping them navigate federal benefits and retirement options, ensuring they have the information needed to plan for their future.

Training and Development: Champion employee growth by helping to identify training needs, coordinating logistics for virtual and in-person courses, and providing direct support to our New Employee Orientation program.

Employee and Labor Relations: Build critical skills by researching and analyzing information, providing recommendations on employee matters, and gaining foundational experience in awards and recognition programs.

Compliance and Records Management: Sharpen your analytical skills by participating in HR program audits, helping to identify and resolve discrepancies to ensure our operations meet the highest federal standards.
EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: GS-05: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least 3 years of progressively responsible experience, 1 year of which was equivalent to at least GS-4, that demonstrates the ability to: Analyze problems to identify significant factors, gather pertinent data, and recognize solutions; Plan and organize work; and Communicate effectively orally and in writing.

You may substitute education for specialized experience as follows: 4-year course of study leading to a bachelor's degree or a bachelor's degree. GS-07: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level (GS-05) in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: experience 1) applying organizational policies and procedures to process a range of personnel or administrative actions; AND 2) providing frontline support for a human resources function (e.g. staffing, benefits administration, employee records, employee/labor relations, etc.) and responding to routine inquiries from employees, managers, or customers.

You may substitute education for specialized experience as follows: One year of graduate-level education, or superior academic achievement (S.A.A.) gained in a bachelor degree curriculum that is qualifying for the position to be filled (based on class standing, grade-point average, or honor society membership).

See the following link for more information: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-policies/#url=app -OR- Combination of education and experience as described above. Less than one year of specialized experience may be combined with completed graduate education.

"Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience. Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

Gemeinsam neue Massstäbe setzen und die Zukunft gestalten - das bedeutet für uns mehr, als Aufgaben einfach abzuarbeiten. Hier arbeitest du mit Menschen zusammen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, hohe Ansprüche haben und den Mut mitbringen, neue Wege zu gehen.

Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen und Leistung Hand in Hand gehen und deine Ideen, deine Initiative und dein Beitrag zählen. So hast du die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, dein Team und deine persönliche Entwicklung.
## Was du bewirkst ##
* Du bist telefonisch und schriftlich die kompetente Ansprechperson für unsere deutsch- und italienischsprachige Kundschaft.
* Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und nutzt Beratungsgespräche aktiv, um passende Versicherungslösungen zu erarbeiten und individuelle Angebote zu erstellen.
* Du gewinnst neue Kundschaft und entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen aktiv weiter (ohne Kaltakquise).
* Du begleitest unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bei Vertragsanpassungen und findest für ihre Anliegen rasch die passende Lösung.
* Du vereinbarst Beratungstermine für den Aussendienst.
## Was du mitbringst ##
* Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Grundbildung.
* Stilsichere Deutsch- und Italienischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich; weitere Sprachkenntnisse, insbesondere Französisch, sind ein Plus.
* Erfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche von Vorteil.
* Freude am telefonischen Kundenkontakt sowie ausgeprägte Beratungs- und Verkaufsstärke.
* Hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung, Empathie und die Fähigkeit, Kundenbedürfnisse rasch zu erkennen.
* Selbstständige, zuverlässige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit sicherem Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen.
* VBV-Zertifizierung oder die Bereitschaft, diese zu erwerben.

Deine Aufgaben
* Du arbeitest im Verkaufs**innendienst** in unserer Agentur Langnau i.E.
* Du bist am Telefon und am Empfang die **erste und kompetente Ansprechperson** für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden
* Du führst **telefonische und persönliche Beratungen** durch und erkennst gezielt Beratungs- und Abschlusschancen im Bestand
* Du erstellst **massgeschneiderte Angebote**, passt Versicherungsdeckungen bedarfsgerecht an und mutierst Kundendaten
* Du stärkst und erweiterst aktiv bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, identifizierst **Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale und überzeugst mit deiner offenen Art neue Kundinnen und Kunden**
* Du beantwortest eingehende schriftliche Kundenanfragen **selbständig, effizient und qualitätsbewusst** gemäss den Vorgaben von Visana
Dein Profil
* Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung und Erfahrung im **Kundenkontakt oder Verkauf**
* Du hast Freude daran, Kundinnen und Kunden **ganzheitlich, lösungsorientiert und verbindlich** zu beraten
* Idealerweise hast du eine **VBV-Zertifizierung**
* Du kommunizierst klar, freundlich und überzeugend - **auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächssituationen**
* Deine Deutschkenntnisse sind sehr gut; jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus
* Du arbeitest **strukturiert, zuverlässig und ergebnisorientiert** und bist sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Programmen
**Wir von Visana gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens - mit Leidenschaft und Innovation.**
Du willst etwas bewirken? Dann bist du bei uns richtig!
Visana ist mit 922'000 Privat- und 16'300 Unternehmenskundinnen und -kunden ein führender Schweizer Allbranchenversicherer mit Sitz in Bern. Wir begleiten unsere Kundinnen und Kunden in den unterschiedlichsten Lebenssituationen - von Gesundheit und Vorsorge über Wohnen und Mobilität bis hin zu individuellen Lösungen für Unternehmen.
Mach den nächsten Karriereschritt - unser Team freut sich auf dich!

Wolt and Roo operate under the DoorDash umbrella, and Customer Support sits at the intersection of brand experience, unit economics and long-term growth. This role owns the strategy on:
Where should we operate support, at what scale, and at what cost, across a rolling multi-year horizon?
How do we architect frontline service design to be AI-ready as frontline tooling evolves, deliver best-in-class customer experience, and remain cost-efficient?
How do we manage our workforce with precision, eliminating waste, consolidating overlapping structures, and continuously improving headcount efficiency through automation and org redesign?
This is a permanent leadership role. The person in this seat will own network strategy, service design and workforce management as a continuous discipline, embedding deeply into Wolt, Roo and DoorDash technology stacks, building and refreshing the financial and operational case for change, and evolving the execution roadmap as the business, technology and market shift.

A. Support Service Design
Own the demand and supply planning, and scheduling for the network, partnering deeply with upstream business owners and defect elimination to enable forecasting accuracy.
Own ongoing assessment of how service is structured and delivered at the frontline across both brands.
Maintain the role architecture map: what roles exist, what they do, where they overlap.
Evaluate how tools (CRM, WFM, knowledge base, AI tools, ticketing) enable or constrain frontline roles, and keep this view current as tooling changes.
Own and evolve the target-state frontline model aligned to AI-augmented ways of working.
Continuously run gap analysis: current state vs. target state, with prioritised interventions.
B. Support Site Strategy
Own the support site footprint across both brands as an ongoing portfolio.
Maintain and refresh strategic site scenarios across cost, quality, risk and scalability as conditions change.
Own the financial model underpinning site strategy: OpEx, CapEx, transition cost, and planning cycles.
Continuously assess BPO vs. in-house mix, nearshore vs. offshore trade-offs, and consolidation opportunities.
Bring forward exec-ready recommendations as circumstances warrant, with clear pros, cons and decision criteria.
Keep the site strategy framed against contact volume reduction through automation.
C. Workforce Management Transformation
Own WFM maturity across both brands on an ongoing basis: demand forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.
Identify and close tooling gaps and duplication across Wolt and Roo WFM stacks.
Own and evolve the consolidated WFM target operating model.

s.h: Own the continuous efficiency case, driven through
s.t:
Org consolidation: merging duplicated WFM roles across the two brands.
Contact automation: defect elimination and end-to-end customer-facing automation.
AI-assisted agent workflows: human-in-the-loop bot interfaces, AI-guided resolution, next-best-action tools.
Scheduling and real-time optimisation via AI/ML tooling.
Own tooling requirements and vendor strategy (shortlists, entries, exits) as an ongoing responsibility.
D. DoorDash Technology Integration
Maintain deep, current working knowledge of DoorDash's support technology stack.
Continuously translate technology capabilities into concrete business levers for the Wolt and Roo context.
Own the dependency map between integration milestones and the Support transformation roadmap.
Flag risks early where integration timelines could affect strategy execution.
E. Execution Planning
Own the rolling execution plan: prioritised initiatives, owners, investment, expected outcomes, refreshed as priorities shift.
Own the forward-looking roadmap: strategic bets, sequencing logic, capability-build requirements.
Own stakeholder alignment across Support Operations, Product, Finance and People functions on an ongoing basis.

Current state visibility: Maintain a living view of service design, site footprint, financial planning cycles and WFM maturity across Wolt & Roo, with an opinionated, forward-looking perspective on where the network needs to go.
DoorDash technology translation: Continuously map DoorDash technology capabilities to Wolt/Roo business levers, tracking upstream product, tooling and integration roadmaps and their implications for network design.
Support site strategy: Maintain a multi-year scenario model with full financial analysis, pros & cons, and a standing recommended path, developed in partnership with the wider Strategy and Operations organisation.
Planning mechanisms: Own and run weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual mechanisms for demand and supply planning (long and short term) and scheduling/real-time management, optimising for customer experience and efficiency, with clear visibility for executive leadership.
WFM transformation: Own the consolidated operating model, tooling spec, and the efficiency case for the organisation, with signed-off financial projections refreshed as the business evolves.
Roadmap ownership: Maintain a rolling forward roadmap covering strategic sequencing, capability investments, and automation maturity milestones, ratified through regular leadership review.
Stakeholder alignment: Keep all key workstream owners briefed, committed and clear on accountabilities on an ongoing basis.
All recommendations must be underpinned by a financial model, and must be decision-ready on first presentation.
Operating Rhythm
Embed & Orient (ongoing as scope evolves): Maintain stakeholder maps; stay immersed in Wolt, Roo & DoorDash systems; keep baseline data current; revisit scope and success criteria as the business changes.
Diagnose: Continuously reassess current state across all workstreams; keep DoorDash tech translation current; surface risks and quick wins as they emerge.
Design & Model: Maintain and evolve site strategy scenarios, the frontline service design blueprint, the WFM target model, and supporting financial models.
Synthesise & Align: Run regular executive forums and stakeholder sign-off cycles.
Roadmap & Continuity: Maintain the forward roadmap; ensure knowledge is embedded across the team rather than concentrated in one person.

Als Customer Support Specialist (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich dafür, unseren Kund:innen über alle Kanäle hinweg schnellen, präzisen und empathischen Support zu bieten. Du übernimmst ihre Fragen und Probleme vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Lösung, hilfst Handwerker:innen dabei, plancraft erfolgreich im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen, und bringst wertvolle Erkenntnisse aus dem Support ein, um unser Produkt und die Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Deine Verantwortlichkeiten
Du übernimmst den gesamten Lifecycle von Kundenanfragen über E-Mail, Chat und Telefon – von der ersten Einordnung und Analyse bis zur Lösung, Nachverfolgung und dem Abschluss.
Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Handwerker:innen bei Produktfragen, technischen Problemen und Fragen zu ihren Workflows.
Du sorgst für schnelle und qualitativ hochwertige Lösungen, steuerst deinen Backlog eigenständig und behältst First Response und Resolution Times im Blick.
Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für deine Fälle und arbeitest bei Bedarf eng mit Customer Success, Product und Engineering zusammen.
Du dokumentierst und kategorisierst Fälle sauber und nachvollziehbar und lieferst damit wertvolle Informationen für Ursachenanalysen.
Du erstellst und pflegst Help-Center-Artikel, Macros und interne Playbooks, um Self-Service-Angebote auszubauen und unseren Support skalierbarer zu machen.
Du erkennst wiederkehrende Probleme, UX-Hürden und Wissenslücken frühzeitig und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse in konkrete Vorschläge für Produkt- und Prozessverbesserungen.
Du hilfst Kund:innen dabei, zentrale plancraft Workflows erfolgreich zu nutzen, löst Blocker und vermittelst Best Practices klar und praxisnah.
Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unserer Support-Automatisierungen und AI-Workflows durch Tests, Feedback und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.
Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Spezialisierungsthemen, beispielsweise als Feature Champion oder bei Onboarding Sessions und Webinaren.

Must-haves
Du hast einen starken Kundenfokus und kommunizierst klar, professionell und empathisch – auch in herausfordernden Gesprächen.
Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und analytisch an und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Kundenanliegen und treibst sie eigenständig bis zur Lösung.
Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bringst eine bodenständige, kooperative Arbeitsweise mit.
Du hast ein gutes technisches Verständnis und gehst sicher mit digitalen Tools und Software um.
Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau.

Provides leadership and direction to employees performing technical work involving taxpayer inquiries, case analysis, and resolution of complex tax issues.

Plans, organizes, and assigns work based on program priorities, workload complexity, and employee capabilities to ensure timely and accurate completion of assignments.

Monitors work in progress and reviews completed work for quality, accuracy, and adherence to applicable tax laws, regulations, and Internal Revenue Manual (IRM) procedures, taking corrective action as needed.

Ensures timely and accurate resolution of inventory and monitors aged inventory using available reports and systems to prevent overage conditions. Provides technical oversight of taxpayer inquiries and case resolution activities by evaluating work performed and ensuring consistent application of tax laws, regulations, and IRM procedures.

Reviews and analyzes cases involving multiple issue areas, complex regulatory requirements, and frequently changing guidance to ensure accurate and compliant resolution. Ensures employees follow established procedures for handling inventory, system usage, and case documentation requirements.

Ensures proper handling of cases involving issues such as compliance determinations, financial hardship, or potential noncompliance. Evaluates determinations made by employees to ensure sound judgment in resolving discrepancies and interpreting taxpayer intent.

Wir von der CSS helfen Menschen, ein gesundes Leben zu führen - was immer das Leben für sie bereithält. Vielleicht ist unsere Mission ja bald auch deine? Uns würde es freuen. Wir sind eine bunte Gruppe ehrgeiziger Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

Einige von uns haben das KV gemacht, andere kommen aus dem Detailhandel, dem Gastgewerbe oder aus einer anderen beruflichen Ecke. Alle bringen ihre Erfahrung ein. Was uns verbindet, ist unsere Leidenschaft für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden da zu sein. Wir helfen einander, halten zusammen und lachen viel.

Und Erfolge feiern wir am liebsten gemeinsam im Team.
## **So sieht dein Alltag aus** ##
* Zum Herzstück: Du überzeugst Menschen von der CSS und machst sie zu Kundinnen und Kunden.
* Diese berätst du persönlich, am Telefon, per E-Mail oder auch mal per Video-Call - in sehr gutem Deutsch, gerne auch in weiteren Sprachen.
* Unser Kundenportfolio wächst dank dir durch Cross- und Upselling.
* Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und ihr unterstützt euch gegenseitig beim Erreichen der gemeinsamen Ziele.
* Ab und zu schaust du über den Tellerrand und übernimmst Zusatzaufgaben oder Projektarbeiten.
## **Das bringst du mit** ##
* Das Wichtigste zuerst: Man merkt dir an, dass du gerne unter Menschen bist - du gehst offen auf sie zu und deine positive Art ist ansteckend.
* Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich, im Detailhandel oder in einem anderen spannenden Beruf - im Idealfall mit Kundenkontakt.
* Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung in der Krankenversicherungsbranche und hast bereits das VBV-Zertifikat erworben - und wenn nicht, unterstützen wir dich dabei.
* Du kannst gut auf dein Gegenüber eingehen, hörst zu und liebst es, andere im Gespräch mit starken Argumenten zu überzeugen.
* Die Digitalisierung ist für dich kein Fremdwort - du kannst gut mit dem Computer umgehen.
* Du hast ein grosses Beziehungsnetz und wohnst vorzugsweise in der Region.
